name: Cinenet Systems
summary: High-speed data network for the film/media industries; built infrastructure linking Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide and Los Angeles; acquired by Superloop (CINENET SYSTEMS PTY LTD, ACN 104 900 030).
